name: Dansende Beren - Verse honing van Dansende Beren
instructions: 'Muziek doorsturen en feedback krijgen kan via mail of onderstaand formulier' - send a mail to beir@dansendeberen.be; they try to reply to everyone. Physical post: Cipressenstraat 18, 8800 Roeselare.
notes: Weekly playlist of all singles written about on the blog; 34 tracks, all 2026 (blackwave., Psychedelic Porn Crumpets, Christine and the Queens). Daily posts in 2026 incl. UK/intl indie rock (Jake Bugg, The Clockworks). Not region-only.

name: mp3hugger - Below The Radar
instructions: Contact page 'Send Your Music!': submit via SubmitHub (sbmt.to/mp3hugger) 'or do it the old fashioned way by dropping us an email' to contact@mp3hugger.com.
notes: Irish indie blog (Kevin, since 2005). Description: 'The best indie tracks below the radar as chosen by music blog mp3hugger.' 459 tracks. Blog posting Nov 2026; playlist update date not visible. SubmitHub route may cost credits. Not region-only.

name: Mowno - MOWNO READERS CLUB
instructions: Groover profile offers 'Add to one of our playlists'; genres alt rock, garage, indie rock, post punk, punk. Playlist itself: 'Chaque fin de mois sur les réseaux sociaux, Mowno lance un appel à contribution' (monthly reader call on socials).
notes: Monthly readers' playlist, 50 tracks incl. 2026 releases (Gurriers, Protomartyr, Fat Dog, Ghinzu). Groover: 99% answer, 2% share rate. Not region-only. URL from Mowno's Spotify account (mowno.com 403s).

name: It's All Indie - Pure Indie
instructions: No submission route found on itsallindie.com, and its old SubmitHub profile (submithub.com/blog/its-all-indie) now returns 404.
notes: Cambridge/Essex indie blog that posts daily (Nov 2026 posts). Playlist is embedded on the homepage. Tracks include Bloc Party, DMA'S, The Big Moon, Raynor and The Kellows: British indie/guitar, a close fit. Follower count not visible.

name: Grimy Goods - Submit Your New Song (open submission playlist)
instructions: Contact page: 'The quickest and most effective way is by submitting songs to our open submission playlist.' Picks move to the Best Songs of the Month playlist, and about 75% of editorial comes from there. Playlist description: the release date must be in the current month, and 'we lean indie and alt across all genres'.
notes: LA indie/alt music site, active (October 2026 best-songs post). Playlist is renamed each month (currently 'Submit Your New Song: NOVEMBER'). Its Best Songs of the Month playlist (70uPifmDGmohAYiTAL713Y) is already in existing.tsv, so it isn't repeated. Not region-only.

name: Turn & Work - Turn & Work: The Setlist
instructions: 'Friday Setlist: a curated playlist of new independent music, sent every Friday to our newsletter subscribers. Requirements: Track link. Ideal lead time: 1 week.' 'If one or more of these sound like a fit for you, please reach out' (the link goes to submissions@turnandwork.com). No AI-made music. Coverage is free.
notes: Independent US site run by Hugh (Spotify owner). Submission guidelines say they 'lean toward indie rock, post-punk, punk rock, hyperpop, and electronic music with English lyrics', with a cap of a few hundred thousand monthly listeners. Updated early every Friday. Not region-only. Email is behind Cloudflare obfuscation on the page (decoded).

name: From The Strait - Limited Time Offer
instructions: Features and Spotify playlist adds, singles only: email Kris with links (YouTube/Spotify/SoundCloud), photos, bio and quotes. No attachments. Release date in the subject line, personal note, at most one follow-up. No AI songs. Paid alternative with guaranteed response: SubmitHub (https://www.submithub.com/blog/from-the-strait, code 'ftscoupon' for 10% off).
notes: Niagara-region site run by Kris and Nolan. Alt rock, indie rock, punk, garage, grunge. Playlist linked from 'The Rundown' posts (latest Nov 5 2026), international acts. Not region-only.

name: Tenho Mais Discos Que Amigos! (TMDQA!) - TMDQA! Lançamentos
instructions: Contact page sends bands to Groover ('Bandas e artistas: envie seu material'). Groover offer: 'Add to our official playlist, publish articles and interviews, share on our social networks.'
notes: Large Brazilian music site (since 2009) covering international music. On Groover it most often accepts alt rock, indie rock and indie pop, and is open to post-punk and garage. 100% answer rate, very active. Not region-only.

name: Niche Music - Niche Music Picks
instructions: 'I turned off all email notifications a few years ago. So if you'd like me to listen to your song, please send it via SubmitHub.' Full-stream link needed. Also on Groover.
notes: One-person Japanese blog (since 2014) introducing overseas independent acts. Alt rock, indie rock, post-punk, shoegaze, dream pop. Wants music like Wolf Alice and Fontaines D.C. Focuses on non-Japanese acts. Free SubmitHub credits may also work.

name: Netsounds - Netsounds New Music
instructions: No explicit submission guidance; about page shows music@netsounds.co.uk as a 'Contact us' link. Site says 'We champion alternative and DIY new music that we love from Scotland and far beyond.'
notes: Inverness-based zine. Playlist embedded on netsounds.co.uk/playlists; description 'Our 2026 New Music playlist. Updated weekly.' 182 tracks. Alt/DIY, Scotland-leaning but not Scotland-only. Posts seen Oct 2026.

name: mp3hugger - Post-Punk & Grunge Are Not Dead
instructions: Contact page 'Send Your Music!': submit via SubmitHub (sbmt.to/mp3hugger) 'or do it the old fashioned way by dropping us an email' to contact@mp3hugger.com.
notes: Same blog as Below The Radar. Description: 'The best new post-punk and grunge tracks as chosen by music blog mp3hugger.com.' 209 tracks. Update date not visible. Fit depends on how guitar-heavy FloodLines' track is.

name: Rock Sins - Rock Sins Weekly Playlist
instructions: Contact page: 'Please send any requests for coverage through to the editorial team.' Lists Features/Live Editor Jamie Giberti (jamieg.rocksins@gmail.com), Deputy Editor Jemma Dodd and News Editor John Layland.
notes: UK rock/metal/heavy webzine. Playlist description: 'best new bands, songs and tours'. Top tracks released late Oct 2026 (Enter Shikari, Breed 77, Blood Command) so it is active. Leans heavier than indie; best for FloodLines' rockier singles. Playlist URL taken from the blog's own embed (rocksins.com weekly playlist post). Curator: Jamie.

name: Picky Magazine - PICKY RADAR
instructions: Impressum lists 'Kontakt: pickypromo[at]gmail.com' (promo address) but does not explicitly invite music submissions.
notes: 'Die New-Release-Playlist von Picky', 70 tracks, all 2026 (Odd Beholder, Pair, Blush Always, TRÄNEN). Indie / indie-pop leaning, German and international. Playlist embedded on same page. Not region-only.

name: Orange Peel - Orange Peel Monthly
instructions: 'Please only send Submissions through Submithub... If we are not listed, we probably don't have time to listen to new submissions for the moment.'
notes: Monthly favourites of the past four weeks ('Updated every other month'), 37 tracks, 2026 entry posted Aug 2026. Eclectic indie/folk/pop/hip-hop. Contact page links only to submithub.com root, exact curator profile not confirmed. Not region-only. The contact page links only to the SubmitHub homepage. A profile exists at submithub.com/blog/orange-peel but I could not confirm it is the same Orange Peel.

name: Mondo Sonoro - Novedades semanales de Mondo Sonoro
instructions: Contact page lists editorial staff emails but no invitation to send music.
notes: Weekly new-releases playlist every Saturday chosen by the editorial team, 33 tracks, international indie/rock incl. UK acts. Large Spanish outlet; embedded on homepage. Not region-only.

name: Tinnitist - Tinnitist Top 300
instructions: 'If you'd rather not use the form, you can email me directly HERE' (decodes to editor@tinnitist.com). Send name, press release/bio and track link. Paid alternatives: Groover (https://groover.co/band/sendtrack/?add=1803), SharePRO and OTONAMI. The site form asks for a donation with a refund if he can't find a spot. Don't use it, because that is pay-for-coverage; the email route is free.
notes: Toronto blog run by Darryl Sterdan (ex-Toronto Sun critic). Very active (157 posts so far in Nov 2026). The playlist is a broad running list: 'The 300+ newest tunes to come my way via various sources'. Mixed genres with plenty of rock. Not region-only.

name: Two Story Melody - Two Story Friday
instructions: 'Or fill out the contact form here. If you're submitting via the form, please include a URL to relevant artist pages, a brief (3-5 sentence) overview of yourself' plus a short description of the song. The SubmitHub link on the page now resolves to a generic SubmitHub page (profile appears inactive), so use the form.
notes: US songwriting-focused blog. Playlist: 'Songs that tell stories, updated weekly.' Indie, folk and alt mix (Hovvdy, Medium Build, Andrew McMahon). Fits a lyric-led indie rock song best. Not region-only.

name: The Wild Honey Pie - The Wild Honey Pie: Buzzing (Apple Music)
instructions: 'Step 1: Upload your new song, demo, or live recording to Tidal Upload' then 'Step 2: Submit your Tidal Upload link here!' (thewildhoneypie.com/submit). No AI music.
notes: US indie site (NYC/LA) that throws parties and makes videos. Apple Music version, 300 songs. The Spotify Buzzing playlist is already in existing.tsv, so only the Apple Music one is new. Indie and pop, weekly. Not region-only.

name: Zonagirante.com - Sonidos novedosos - Novel sounds - Sons nouveaux
instructions: Via Groover. 'I promise to listen to your material several times... I will make a complete review with my opinion.' Other playlists are Latin America only; this one appears open to all.
notes: Bogotá webzine run by its director (ex-Rolling Stone Colombia writer). Alt rock, indie rock, indie pop. Wants music like The Charlatans, Ride, BRMC, so suits UK alt. 100% answer rate.

name: Oleada Indie - pop alternativo 2026
instructions: Via Groover (homepage 'Envíanos' widget). Offer: add to the 'nuevo indie 2026' playlist, YouTube video and article.
notes: Mexican Spanish-language indie blog, active Sept–Nov 2026. Leans dream pop, shoegaze and indie pop, so weak for guitar-led alt rock. The SubmitHub slug in its widget returns 404.
